title: 老干妈的AI，怎么挑出坏辣椒？
title_en: How Does an AI Spot a Bad Chili?

segments.zh: 据报道，老干妈挑辣椒的工人，
segments.en: Reportedly, Laoganma's chili sorters

segments.zh: 从六百多人变成了四十八人。
segments.en: went from over six hundred to forty-eight.

segments.zh: 顶替他们的，是传送带上方的高速相机，
segments.en: Replacing them: high-speed cameras over the belt,

segments.zh: 每零点三秒扫一遍。
segments.en: scanning every 0.3 seconds.

segments.zh: 据报道，挑出来的坏辣椒，
segments.en: Reportedly, the bad chilies

segments.zh: 是被一股气流直接吹走的。
segments.en: are simply blown away by a jet of air.

segments.zh: 公司回应：裁员传闻不实，
segments.en: The company says the layoff rumor is false,

segments.zh: 而且从来没用过这么多拣椒工。
segments.en: and it never had that many sorters.

segments.zh: 人数之争我们先放一边，
segments.en: Let's leave the head count aside

segments.zh: 今天只问一个烧脑问题：
segments.en: and ask one brain-teaser:

segments.zh: 一台机器，从没吃过辣椒，
segments.en: A machine that has never tasted a chili —

segments.zh: 凭什么一眼看出哪颗是坏的？
segments.en: how does it spot a bad one at a glance?

segments.zh: 第一步，先说个秘密：
segments.en: First, a secret:

segments.zh: 在相机眼里，根本没有辣椒。
segments.en: to a camera, there is no chili.

segments.zh: 只有几百万个小格子，叫像素，
segments.en: Only millions of tiny squares called pixels,

segments.zh: 每一格，就是三个数：红、绿、蓝。
segments.en: each just three numbers: red, green, blue.

segments.zh: 你的手机屏幕也是这么拼出来的，
segments.en: Your phone screen works the same way:

segments.zh: 凑近看，全是红绿蓝的小点。
segments.en: up close, it's all red, green and blue dots.

segments.zh: 好辣椒的格子，红的数很大，
segments.en: Good chili pixels: big red,

segments.zh: 绿和蓝都很小。
segments.en: small green and blue.

segments.zh: 霉斑、黑斑呢？
segments.en: Mold and black spots?

segments.zh: 三个数都很小，黑乎乎一片。
segments.en: All three numbers small. Dark.

segments.zh: 有的分拣机还看人眼看不见的光，
segments.en: Some sorters even see light our eyes can't,

segments.zh: 有些毛病在那种光下更显眼。
segments.en: where some flaws stand out more.

segments.zh: 最笨的办法：数一数黑格子，
segments.en: The dumbest method: count dark pixels;

segments.zh: 超过一定数量，就判它坏。
segments.en: too many, and it's bad.

segments.zh: 反转一：
segments.en: Twist one:

segments.zh: 这招很快就翻车。
segments.en: that trick breaks fast.

segments.zh: 辣椒的影子是黑的，蒂把也是深色的，
segments.en: Shadows are dark. Stems are dark.

segments.zh: 一颗好椒也会被冤枉。
segments.en: A perfectly good chili gets framed.

segments.zh: 所以现在用AI：
segments.en: So now we use AI:

segments.zh: 给它看成千上万张标好的照片。
segments.en: show it thousands of labeled photos.

segments.zh: 这叫监督学习：
segments.en: That's called supervised learning:

segments.zh: 人先把答案标好，它照着学。
segments.en: people label the answers, and it learns from them.

segments.zh: 这张好，那张坏，
segments.en: This one good, that one bad,

segments.zh: 它自己琢磨出霉斑长什么样。
segments.en: and it works out what mold looks like.

segments.zh: 就像老师傅带徒弟：
segments.en: Like a master training an apprentice:

segments.zh: 不讲规则，只让你看一万颗。
segments.en: no rules, just look at ten thousand.

segments.zh: 徒弟看多了就有了手感，
segments.en: Look long enough and you get a feel.

segments.zh: AI的手感，就是一大堆调好的数字。
segments.en: An AI's feel is a pile of tuned numbers.

segments.zh: 反转二，最反直觉：
segments.en: Twist two, the weird one:

segments.zh: 看出来不难，难的是追上它。
segments.en: spotting is easy. Catching is hard.

segments.zh: 传送带一直在跑，
segments.en: The belt never stops.

segments.zh: 等算完，那颗辣椒已经往前走了。
segments.en: By the time the math is done, the chili has moved.

segments.zh: 这就像接球：
segments.en: It's like catching a ball:

segments.zh: 你不是追着球跑，是先猜它落在哪。
segments.en: you don't chase it, you guess where it will land.

segments.zh: 所以机器要算准：它现在在哪，
segments.en: So the machine works out where it is now,

segments.zh: 几分之一秒后会到哪。
segments.en: and where it'll be a split second later.

segments.zh: 到了那一点，一个小喷嘴，
segments.en: At that spot, a tiny nozzle

segments.zh: 噗，吹一口气。
segments.en: goes pfft: one puff of air.

segments.zh: 色选机的喷气阀，开关只要几毫秒，
segments.en: A sorter's air valve opens in a few milliseconds,

segments.zh: 比眨一下眼快几十倍。
segments.en: dozens of times faster than a blink.

segments.zh: 坏辣椒被吹飞，掉进废料槽，
segments.en: The bad chili flies into the reject bin;

segments.zh: 好辣椒继续往前走。
segments.en: the good ones roll on.

segments.zh: 据报道，从看见到吹走，
segments.en: Reportedly, from spotted to blown away

segments.zh: 也就零点三秒左右。
segments.en: takes about 0.3 seconds.

segments.zh: 吹早了吹到邻居，吹晚了吹个空，
segments.en: Too early hits the neighbor, too late hits air.

segments.zh: 这是一道物理题。
segments.en: It's a physics problem.

segments.zh: 假如传送带每秒走一米，
segments.en: If the belt moves one meter a second,

segments.zh: 晚百分之一秒，就偏一厘米。
segments.en: a hundredth of a second late is a centimeter off.

segments.zh: 反转三：
segments.en: Twist three:

segments.zh: 机器看得见，不等于看得懂。
segments.en: seeing isn't understanding.

segments.zh: 颜色怪、其实没坏的，
segments.en: Odd color but perfectly fine?

segments.zh: 它可能吹掉。
segments.en: It might blow it away.

segments.zh: 坏在里面、外面看不出的，
segments.en: Rotten inside, clean outside?

segments.zh: 它可能放过。
segments.en: It might let it pass.

segments.zh: 所以还留着四十八位老师傅，
segments.en: That's why forty-eight experienced workers remain

segments.zh: 守最后一道关。
segments.en: on the final check.

segments.zh: 据报道，关键工序的不良率，
segments.en: Reportedly, the defect rate at the key step

segments.zh: 降到了万分之二。
segments.en: fell to 0.02 percent.

segments.zh: 友情提示：这是公司说的数字，
segments.en: Fine print: that's the company's figure,

segments.zh: 不是食品安全抽检结果。
segments.en: not a food safety test result.

segments.zh: 人数怎么变的，各方说法不一，
segments.en: Accounts of the head count differ;

segments.zh: 我们只讲机器怎么看。
segments.en: we only explain how the machine sees.

segments.zh: 同样的办法，早就用在挑米、挑豆、挑茶叶，
segments.en: The same trick sorts rice, beans and tea,

segments.zh: 也帮机器人分拣快递。
segments.en: and helps robots sort parcels.

segments.zh: 机器人学里，这叫感知、决策、执行：
segments.en: In robotics it's called sense, think, act:

segments.zh: 看见、算好、出手。
segments.en: see it, work it out, make the move.

segments.zh: 所以答案是：机器不懂辣，
segments.en: So the answer: the machine knows nothing about spice.

segments.zh: 它只认得三个数，和一口气。
segments.en: Just three numbers, and one puff of air.

segments.zh: 下次你吃到一瓶没有坏椒的辣酱，
segments.en: Next time your chili sauce has no bad chili,

segments.zh: 记得谢谢那一口气。
segments.en: thank that puff of air.
